options.goal: Repair form/form-stdlib/form-cli-turn-evidence-target-bind.fk. An actual JSON cost report was accepted as a turn id, causing repeated full transcript scans. Admit an empty line as latest, or a nonempty raw identifier containing only ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, underscore, dot and colon. EOF/nothing, JSON documents, whitespace and all other bytes must exit nonzero with a useful diagnostic BEFORE any collector state write. Valid input must preserve the existing target write, five reset writes and latest/historical output. Keep this existing entry path; express the implementation in high-grammar BML with section [form.bml], native core/fctel preludes and no new runtime. The supplied native-admission example shows the BML entry surface. Native primitives available: read_line(), nothing?(value), str_len(text), str_byte_at(text,index), str_find(text,pattern,start), substring(text,start,end), str_eq(a,b), and/or/not, numeric comparisons, recursive functions, form_error(text), write_file_text(path,text), print_str(text), file_size(path). str_find miss is -1; character allow-list lookup must compare >=0. Preserve empty versus absent. Only the selector file is writable; existing documents use guarded edit. The caller checker compiles and runs the actual entry in an isolated directory; invalid input must preserve all six state files and valid input must set/reset them exactly. Do not run a landing or publish files; implement, review and verify.

documents.text:
; form-cli-turn-evidence-target-bind.fk — optionally select one completed turn
; for a historical Form-native re-witness. An empty line returns to latest.
;
; preflight-exec: forbidden
;
; preludes: form-stdlib/core.fk
; preludes: form-stdlib/form-cli-turn-evidence-live.fk

(do
    (let turn-id (read_line))
    (write_file_text (fctel-target-turn-path) turn-id)
    (write_file_text (fctel-discovery-path) "")
    (write_file_text (fctel-progress-path) "")
    (write_file_text (fctel-start-discovery-path) "")
    (write_file_text (fctel-candidate-row-path) "")
    (write_file_text (fctel-latest-validation-path) "")
    (print_str (if (eq (file_size (fctel-target-turn-path)) 0)
        "turn-evidence-target=latest\n"
        "turn-evidence-target=historical\n"))
    0)

contract: turn-selector-v1: actual CLI compile and isolated execution; preserve all six state files on invalid report, EOF, whitespace, quote, array, slash or non-ASCII; retain empty latest and historical ASCII identifier behavior
